name: Kohath
overview: Kohath, a son of Levi, is a foundational figure in the Levitical lineage, as Scripture records him among Levi's sons alongside Gershon and Merari (Genesis 46:11; Exodus 6:16). He is notably the father of Amram, who was the father of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam, marking Kohath as their grandfather (Exodus 6:18; Numbers 3:19, 27; Numbers 26:58). The descendants of Kohath, known as the Kohathites, formed one of the key divisions of the Levites, entrusted with specific duties in Israel's worship and service (Numbers 3:27). This lineage highlights God's providential preparation for the leadership and priestly roles fulfilled by Moses and Aaron.
